what_this_is: The exact attribution of the verification pass (docs/gate1/exact-attribution-brief-2026-11-16.md; D-65 item 4), with the reference repair (docs/gate1/reference-repair-rule-2026-11-18.md; D-72 item 4). Load and sales only. Counts are reports; none is a target.
place_test_reference: The place test's reference is a conditional diagnostic (D-90). It is the utility's reference only on the condition that every provisional convention is the site's start: the place test does not read the provisional mark, so its list of reference-defining questions is narrower than the exact attribution's. It cannot override an undefined exact reference, and neither it nor "keeps its place" is by itself a ground for eligibility or for pruning a question.

expansion.what_this_is: D-61 section 4: the expansion test on scratch copies; load and sales only; the place of touched utilities and nothing else
expansion.guarantee: The joint check covers modeled loads and enumerated uncertainties only (D-65 item 5). A row with no size or no start year carries no load in any setting, which is a limit of the inventory and not a finding. The generic screen on uncorrected permit-dated rows is not a question in it, and the map's choice of utility is not rerun when a factor moves.
